# Introduction {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-warning}
This chapter is a placeholder. Planned content:

- What this site is; relationship to WRE / R Internals / Advanced R
- Audience and prerequisites
- Conventions used throughout: always `R_NO_REMAP` + `Rf_`/`R_` prefixes,
  C not C++, `.Call` only
- The API status taxonomy (API / experimental / embedding / non-API) and
  what "don't use non-API" means in practice (`R CMD check` NOTEs, CRAN
  policy)
- Which headers to include and why `<Rinternals.h>` is fine
:::

Out of scope for this site: the `.C`/`.Fortran` interface as a recommended
approach, embedding R / writing front-ends, the graphics engine API, and
non-API entry points except where the [compliance appendix](compliance.qmd)
maps them to replacements.
